title: PrintReturnReceiptRequest
description:
Op 6 request: print a return/refund receipt — the operation that actually registers a return.

With no amounts/items it returns the whole receipt; set the `*_for_return` amounts and/or
`return_item_list` for a partial return. The original spec §4.5.7 is
"ՀԴՄ վերադարձի կտրոնի տպում" = *print return receipt*. The spec describes it in section §4.5.7,
but its wire operation code is **6** per the operation-codes table (§4.3). The read-only lookup
of the receipt being returned is op 10, [`GetReturnableReceiptRequest`].

crn.description: HDM registration number of the device that printed the receipt.

returnTicketId.description: Number of the receipt to be returned.

cashAmountForReturn.description: Cash amount to return (only set if returning partial payments).

cardAmountForReturn.description: Card amount to return (only set if returning partial payments).

prePaymentAmountForReturn.description: Prepayment amount to return (only set if returning partial payments).

returnItemList.description: Per-item return list (only set if returning specific items partially).

ReturnItem.description: Per-item entry in a partial-return request.

rpid.description: Row sequence number of the item being returned.

quantity.description: Quantity of this row's items to return.
